text: Implemented durable managed control: storage-neutral ControlStore and pure command reducer; canonical request bytes plus SHA-256 digest persisted before scheduler action; transactional submit/cancel outbox; SubmissionKey idempotency and pre-action digest conflicts; AcceptanceUnknown recovery without blind retry; unique binding reconciliation, binding history, attempt epochs and fencing; current/stale/unavailable evidence; resumable committed cursors; restart recovery; bounded coalesced jittered observation with per-site leases; terminal accounting and focused fallback. Added a single-writer framed append-only file journal with schema version, checksums, fsync-before-projection, private path validation, partial-tail recovery, corruption/lock rejection, and bounded query/event pages. Verification: managed 29/29; full repository 91/91 on Scala 3.3.8 and 91/91 on 3.8.4; checkFormatting and cross-managed packageBin pass. Static audit found no unbounded queue or Int.MaxValue in managed production code. Known limits documented in ADR 0004: AcceptanceSearch is a site adapter boundary, journal replay/query is O(n), no compaction, and P4 supplies typed result fencing.
